# Current Provenance Decision

This supporting decision is the current head of the fabricated chain. It was created on 2026-02-15T09:00:00Z by agent:alice, uses decision identifier `dec-003`, and supersedes `dec-002`.

The decision narrows the earlier tagging plan. Instead of requiring a controlled vocabulary on every note, reviewers only normalize high-risk records: commitments, authority records, and decisions that participate in a supersedence chain. Lower-risk concept notes can remain descriptive as long as they keep valid frontmatter.

The change keeps the vault simple while preserving the ability to detect stale commitments, alias collisions, and outdated decisions. It also gives the test fixture a clean head record that should remain current.

## Current Rule

When a note changes the operational meaning of an earlier note, it must declare the replaced decision through `supersedes`. Only one record in the chain should be marked as the head. In this fixture, `dec-003` is the head and `dec-002` is stale.

## Test Expectation

A graph query should be able to follow `dec-003` back to `dec-002` and then to `dec-001`. The query should not infer that `dec-002` is current, because this file provides the later replacement.

## Review Consequence

When reviewers inspect this chain, they should report one current rule and two historical rules. The current rule is the narrowed provenance rule in this file. The historical rules remain useful as explanation, but neither one should be selected as the active head.
